metric_definitions.normalization: 0 background; original 1 or 255 foreground; source bytes retained

metric_definitions.filled_area: scipy.ndimage.binary_fill_holes area; derived QC, not ground truth
metric_definitions.closed_curve_candidate: one component, no endpoints/branches, one enclosed hole
metric_definitions.hashes: SHA256 of C-order source pixel bytes; shape/dtype required for comparison
